en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of an industrial complex on a wooded shoreline with factories, a tall smokestack, piles of raw material, and several buildings. The site is surrounded by forest and water in a coastal or lakeside landscape. Caption text at the bottom left identifies the place as "Nensjö Cellulosa A. B., Språngsviken." A photographer/publisher credit appears at the bottom right.
